articles.title: Photon Versus Proton Whole-Body Irradiation Combined with Olaparib
articles.summary: This study compared oxidative stress and DNA damage response in C57BL/6 mice receiving whole-body irradiation from either photon or proton beams when combined with the PARP inhibitor Olaparib. Findings provide insights into multi-organ oxidative toxicity profiles associated with these radiation modalities in combination therapy.

articles.title: Model-Based Normal Tissue Complication Probability Comparison: Proton vs. Photon
articles.summary: This planning study compared normal tissue complication probability (NTCP) between proton and photon therapies for brain tumors. The results suggest potential clinical benefits for proton therapy in reducing the risk of secondary cancers in long-term survivors.

articles.title: Impact of Anatomical Changes on Proton Arc and Intensity-Modulated Proton Therapy
articles.summary: This research evaluated the robustness of simulated proton arc therapy (sPAT) versus intensity-modulated proton therapy (IMPT) in the context of lung cancer radiotherapy. The findings indicate that sPAT may offer enhanced resilience against inter-fractional anatomical variations.

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence in Precision Radiotherapy for Head and Neck Cancer
articles.summary: A review of how AI, multi-omics, and multimodal integration are being used to characterize tumor and host heterogeneity in head and neck cancer. The article examines the transition from biological insights to clinical decision-making in precision radiotherapy.

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence, Multi-Omics, and Multimodal Integration in Precision Radiotherapy for Head and Neck Cancer
articles.summary: This narrative review explores how artificial intelligence, multi-omics, and multimodal analysis can be utilized to better characterize tumor heterogeneity in head and neck cancer. It emphasizes the importance of linking these measurements to clinical outcomes to refine treatment decision-making.

articles.title: Clinical Outcomes and Safety of Spatially Fractionated Radiotherapy for Malignant Tumors
articles.summary: This systematic review evaluates the current evidence for spatially fractionated radiotherapy, a technique that delivers high doses to specific tumor regions while sparing surrounding healthy tissue. It provides an evidence map of existing clinical outcomes and treatment delivery approaches.

articles.title: Impact of anatomical changes on simulated proton arc therapy and intensity-modulated proton therapy for lung cancer
articles.summary: This study evaluated the robustness of proton arc therapy compared to intensity-modulated proton therapy (IMPT) in the context of lung cancer treatment. The findings indicate that proton arc therapy exhibits superior robustness against inter-fractional anatomical variations.

articles.title: Model-Based Normal Tissue Complication Probability Comparison Between Proton and Photon Therapies for Brain Tumors
articles.summary: This planning study compared proton beam therapy (PBT) and intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) for brain tumors. PBT demonstrated lower estimated normal tissue complication probabilities for several endpoints, potentially offering long-term benefits in reducing secondary cancer risks.

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence, Multi-Omics, and Multimodal Integration in Precision Radiotherapy for Head and Neck Cancer
articles.summary: This narrative review explores how AI and multi-omics data integration can enhance precision radiotherapy by characterizing tumor heterogeneity. It emphasizes the importance of linking biological insights and multimodal data to inform individualized treatment decisions.

articles.title: Clinical Outcomes and Safety of Spatially Fractionated Radiotherapy for Malignant Tumors: A Systematic Review and Evidence Map
articles.summary: This systematic review assesses clinical outcomes and safety profiles associated with spatially fractionated radiotherapy (SFRT). It provides an evidence map of current techniques to help clinicians understand the comparative efficacy of this modality in treating malignant tumors.

articles.title: DoseRAD2026: A benchmark dataset for AI-accelerated photon and proton dose calculation in radiotherapy
articles.summary: This article introduces the DoseRAD2026 benchmark dataset designed to support research in fast and accurate dose calculation for both CT and MRI-guided radiotherapy. The dataset aims to facilitate the development of AI-driven solutions for real-time adaptive treatment planning.

articles.title: Dose-Informed Surgical Margin in Mandibular Osteoradionecrosis Surgery: Integrating Radiation Biology into Osteotomy Planning
articles.summary: This study explores moving beyond anatomical landmarks by integrating radiation biology into surgical planning for mandibular osteoradionecrosis. The researchers aim to improve outcomes for head and neck radiotherapy patients through more biologically informed surgical margins.

articles.title: Diagnostic CT-Based Palliative Radiotherapy Using kV Image Verification: A Prospective Feasibility Study
articles.summary: This feasibility study investigates the use of existing diagnostic CT scans for palliative radiotherapy planning instead of dedicated simulation CTs. The workflow, utilizing kV image verification, aims to increase access and efficiency for patients with bone metastases.

articles.title: A novel automatic real-time motion tracking method in MRI-guided radiotherapy
articles.summary: Researchers have developed an automatic real-time markerless motion tracking method for MRI-guided radiotherapy (MRIgRT). The study demonstrates high precision in tracking and segmentation, suggesting significant potential for improving radiotherapy efficacy.

articles.title: Preclinical Highlights from PTCOG 64
articles.summary: A summary of breakthroughs from the 64th Annual Meeting of the Particle Therapy Co-Operative Group, focusing on the integration of advanced imaging, biological modeling, and digital twins. The report highlights emerging technologies expected to impact the next generation of precision particle therapy.

articles.title: Charge collection efficiency in ionisation chambers at ultra-high dose rates
articles.summary: This study develops a Monte Carlo framework to investigate charge collection efficiency in plane-parallel ionisation chambers during FLASH radiotherapy. The research accounts for space-charge effects and ion recombination necessary for accurate dosimetry at ultra-high dose rates.

articles.title: Preclinical highlights from the 64th Annual Meeting of the Particle Therapy Co-Operative Group (PTCOG 64)
articles.summary: This report highlights developments from PTCOG 64, noting that particle therapy is shifting toward an integrated framework that includes advanced imaging, biological modeling, and digital twins. These technologies are identified as critical drivers for the next generation of precision particle therapy.

articles.title: Preclinical highlights from the 64th Annual Meeting of the Particle Therapy Co-Operative Group (PTCOG 64)
articles.summary: This summary highlights that particle therapy is evolving into an integrated field combining advanced imaging, radiation quality, and patient-specific decision support. Several innovative technologies are reaching clinical maturity, including digital twins and biologically optimized multi-ion therapy.
